routeBuilder.title: Route Builder
routeBuilder.subtitle: Drag cities to reorder · Assign days
routeBuilder.empty: First add cities to the destination field
routeBuilder.explanation: Uses the Nearest Neighbor algorithm: starting from the departure city, always picks the closest unvisited city using Haversine distance (great-circle arc). This avoids unnecessary zigzags — for short lists this is nearly optimal.
routeBuilder.optimizeFallbackStart: Without a departure city, optimization starts from the first city in the list.
routeBuilder.optimizeNoChange: Order is already optimal, or city names aren’t in our coordinate list — adjust names or set departure.

hub.title: Where from & when
hub.body: Set your departure city — we’ll look for flights from there. Pick exact dates: they drive ticket prices and seasonality. Returning to a different city? Toggle “Different city”.

inspiration.title: Where to
inspiration.body: Add several cities one by one: type a name, tap Add or pick from popular — then type the next (e.g. Tokyo, then Osaka). You can’t enter “Tokyo; Osaka” in one go. Not sure where to go? Tap “Surprise me” for an offbeat pick.

routeConstructor.title: Route builder
routeConstructor.body: With 2+ cities you’ll see “Builder”. Drag cities to reorder, assign days per city manually or leave “AI” to distribute days. “Auto-optimize” sorts cities geographically from your departure.

budget.title: Budget & interests
budget.body: Pick a comfort level or a total trip budget. Below, tag what excites you — the AI weaves it into each day.

highlight.title: Trip highlight
highlight.body: Describe one special wish: “find the best ramen”, “sunrise on the volcano”, “catch a jazz festival”. The AI slots it as its own activity on the right day.

team.title: Who travels
team.body: Pick your travel style — the itinerary adapts: solo gets hostels & groups, families get kid-friendly stops & family rooms, couples get romantic evenings.

meta.title: TraveLLM — Your AI Travel Assistant
meta.description: Free within monthly limits: day-by-day AI itineraries with rough costs, weather, and an in-trip chat—built in about a minute (Gemini/DeepSeek). English UI; USD-aware tips.
meta.ogTitle: TraveLLM — Day-by-day AI trips with prices & chat
meta.ogDescription: Plan faster: hourly pacing, activities, budget hints, and route chat in the browser—no app install. Start free, upgrade only if you hit limits.
meta.keywords: AI trip planner, day by day itinerary generator, free travel itinerary maker, AI vacation planner, Gemini travel app, plan a trip with AI, travel budget estimator, weather in itinerary, TraveLLM, smart travel assistant
meta.faq1A: Route generation and AI chat run under monthly per-account limits; there is no separate subscription for the basic flow—check the current limits in the app after sign-in.
meta.faq2A: Itineraries and chat use modern models (including Gemini via OpenRouter and DeepSeek) with fallbacks for reliability.
meta.faq3Q: What do I get in an itinerary?
meta.faq3A: A day-by-day plan with activities, rough costs and tips, weather hints, and booking links where relevant—all in your browser.
meta.faq4Q: Do I need to install an app?
meta.faq4A: No—TraveLLM is a web app; you create and edit trips in the browser on phone or desktop.

chat.welcomeMessage:
Hi! I'm your AI trip assistant (Gemini).

Ask a question, attach a photo, or request a change:
• "What's the weather like?"
• "Replace the museum with a café on day 2"
• "Rewrite days 3–5 for a slower pace"
• "Rewrite the rest of the trip from the day I'm viewing"
• "Do I need a visa?"
